name: Proventus Agrocom Ltd
tagline: Small-cap branded health-food company (dry fruits, nuts, seeds, berries, healthy snacking) with genuinely improving fundamentals this pass - ROCE up from 7% to 12%, operating and free cash flow both turning positive after years negative, no pledge, and a raised FY28 revenue target - but this pass also found a confirmed STATUTORY auditor resignation (NBT & Co., mid-way through its 5-year term) that the original 'no red flags' pass missed.
business_overview: Proventus Agrocom Ltd (NSE: PROV), incorporated 2015, is an integrated branded health-food company spanning dry fruits, nuts, seeds, berries and healthy-snacking products under the 'ProV' brand (ProV Select, Premium, Regal, Flavors, Fusion, Minis, Indulgence), riding the shift from unorganized/loose dry-fruit trade to organized, branded retail and modern-trade/e-commerce/export channels. Its stated strategy is to first master trading/distribution of a product category (building margin and demand/supply knowledge) before progressing up the value chain into branded retail - which explains the historically thin blended EBITDA margin (a mix of low-margin trading and higher-margin branded revenue). Scaling manufacturing capacity across Mumbai (47,000 sq.ft., 1.5 lakh pouches/day, fully operational) and a new Surat, Gujarat facility (2,00,000 sq.ft., Phase 1 ready, targeting 4+ lakh pouches/day combined by FY27).

fundamentals_narrative: This deep-dive pass finds a genuinely improving picture on nearly every operating metric, a positive contrast to the original pass's more static framing: ROCE has moved from 7% (FY24) to 12% (FY25), not sat flat at ~11.5%; PAT was flat FY24-FY25 (Rs 7 Cr both years) before a real inflection to Rs 14 Cr in FY26 (+100%); and - most notably - both operating cash flow and free cash flow turned positive in FY26 (+Rs 9 Cr and +Rs 7 Cr respectively) after being negative in prior years, a genuine quality-of-earnings improvement rather than the negative-cash-flow-despite-profit pattern found in several other names reviewed in this project's recent batches. The Surat facility (Phase 1 ready) is on track to lift combined pouch capacity from 1.5 lakh to 4+ lakh/day by FY27, and management raised its FY28 revenue target to Rs 1,100 Cr from Rs 1,000 Cr - a positive guidance revision, not a cut. Promoter holding is stable-to-modestly-declining (67.21-67.34%) with zero pledge. However, this pass also found a confirmed, dated fact the original 'no red flags' light pass did not check for: Proventus's STATUTORY auditor, NBT & Co. (appointed for a 5-year term running to 2028), resigned mid-term, creating a casual vacancy that the board must fill by ordinary resolution. This is a more serious event than an internal or secretarial auditor change - a statutory auditor resigning before its term concludes is the specific, named HIGH CAUTION trigger this project's framework watches for, and the reason for the resignation was not disclosed in the sources reviewed this pass.

verdict_headline: A genuinely improving small-cap growth story - ROCE trending up, cash flow turning positive, capacity expansion on track, raised FY28 target - but this pass found a confirmed statutory auditor resignation mid-term that the original light pass missed. HIGH CAUTION set; conviction downgraded to Low-Medium pending clarity on the resignation and its replacement auditor.

value_chain.note: The unorganized-to-organized tailwind is real and shared with several unlisted competitors; Proventus's differentiator is a disclosed, deliberate trade-then-brand strategy that explains its currently thin blended margin rather than indicating weak unit economics on the branded portion specifically.

Moat weak: brand differentiation exists but the category remains commodifiable, and much of revenue still runs through a lower-margin trading model. Valuation weak: P/E ~41x is full even after a modest pullback.
